name: Deai Asagiri: Tabako no Nokoriga to Yoake no Kimi
original_name: 出会い朝霧:煙草の残り香と夜明けの君
source:
After years together, your girlfriend Chisa Tsukiyama suddenly decides to leave to study overseas.
No argument or plea can change it -- only five final days remain.
During the final five days, you silently agree not to speak of the future, only the present, as if nothing is ending.
Every kiss, every claim on each other grows more intense than before.
And Chisa -- more yielding, more accepting -- offers herself to you without resistance.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01532102.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在一起多年后，你的女友月山千纱突然决定出国留学。
任何争论或恳求都无法改变它——只剩下最后五天了。
在最后的五天里，你默默地同意不谈论未来，只谈论现在，仿佛一切都没有结束。
每一个吻，每一次对彼此的要求都比以前更加强烈。
而Chisa——更顺从、更包容——毫无抵抗地向你奉献自己。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01532102.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
